j4q.activities

Class GameEngineScene

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.activities.GameEngineScene

  • public class GameEngineScene
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents a scene in the game engine, managing the root object, rendering, and scene state.

    The GameEngineScene class handles scene graph management, OpenGL buffer setup, projection/view matrix updates, lighting, and activity lifecycle integration.
